title: Normalized line traces and their base-change equation
statement:
Use the finite purity coefficient setting [def-pur-conventions] and the affine-line model [def-sbc-affine-space]. Work with the ordinary fixed-coefficient small pro-etale derived operations [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and specified compactifications [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. For $s\geq0$ with $\ell^{s+1}A=0$, put $N=\ell^{s+1}$ and use the shifted Tate line $T=A(1)[2]$ of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. For a finite-type $k$-scheme $S$, define $t_S:Ra_{S!}T_S\to A_S$ to be the normalized affine-line integration of [def-pur-affine-line-purity-comparison], expressed on the affine-chart compactification by its canonical Tate-coordinate comparison. For a quasi-compact $f:X\to Y$ with $X$ finite type over $k$, let $q:\mathbf A^1_X\to X$ and $r:\mathbf A^1_X\to\mathbf A^1_Y$ be the base-changed line square [def-pc-fibre-product]. Define $t_X^{\mathrm{pull}}:Rq_!Lr^*T_Y\to A_X$ by $t_X$ preceded by the canonical roots-normalized Tate pullback and change-of-compactification comparisons. More generally, for any finite commutative $A$, $N\in\mathbf N$ with $NA=0$, any $f:X\to Y$ and maps $t_Y:Ra_{Y!}T_Y\to A_Y$, $t_X:Rq_!Lr^*T_Y\to A_X$, define the trace-compatibility predicate to be exactly
$$Lf^*(t_Y);u_f=\mathrm{Ex}_!;t_X,$$
where $u_f:Lf^*A_Y\simeq A_X$ is the canonical unit comparison and $\mathrm{Ex}_!$ is the specified compact-support exchange [def-exchange-projection]. The predicate asserts only this equation; its truth is not part of the definition.

def normalizedPulledTrace (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f]
    (s : ℕ) (hA : ((P.coefficients.l ^ (s + 1) : ℕ) : Ring P) = 0)
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType (f ≫ aY)] [QuasiCompact (f ≫ aY)]
